objective: Safely guard BUKLOD production Android account registration against confirmed device offline conditions without replaying auth signup, losing form state, exposing credentials or changing live account recovery semantics.
productionBaselineEvidence: GitHub main source at 9f412afd71b74e41995a3a1a63e05e72f78b6e39; this is source only, not evidence of served Android production runtime. Production Supabase project active/healthy at incident inspection; no originating request identity correlated.
chosenApproach: Use the existing native NetInfo module only at explicit account creation or interrupted-account verification boundaries; block network mutations only if OS reports definitely offline. Unknown connectivity continues to existing server-safe auth and login recovery.
selectionRationale: An offline-first guard improves failure guidance without changing Supabase credentials, auth requests, backend, native dependencies, or automatic replay. Weak-signal and ambiguous server commits remain safely handled by existing sign-in-only verification.
alternativeApproaches: Blindly retry Auth signup on connection reset: rejected due to duplicate account/uncertain commit risk.
Create privileged API endpoints or alter Auth/RLS for status lookup: rejected as unnecessary exposure.
Block signup on an inconclusive NetInfo probe: rejected because it may report unknown while Internet actually works.
preserveBehaviors: Exactly one auth.signUp invocation and no auto retry after an ambiguous network failure.
Existing password verification, account status and session checks remain authoritative before local setup and referral linking.
No client account bypass or privileged account discovery from anonymous users.
No new native dependency, no changes to BUKLOD media, ads, call, UI navigation or database.
Registration details remain in existing form state and single-flight loading guard resets on every error path.
acceptanceChecks: Offline detection only blocks definitively disconnected devices; unknown probe failures permit signup.
Interrupted status check does not trigger a new signup; on reconnect uses the existing login verification.
Existing registration-network-recovery tests pass and new source regression tests validate ordering.
TypeScript and Android source/export compile required before any production OTA.
Actual weak-network/offline Android behavior and exact production runtime/source compatibility remain separate release prerequisites.

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Add a narrow confirmed-offline guard to the existing Android registration screen without affecting other runtime features.
preservedBehaviors: Protect all existing account creation, single-flight, referral and local setup controls, and unrelated media/ads/navigation.

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Avoid transmitting registration and recovery Auth requests during definite OS-reported disconnection while preserving existing server-based verification.
preservedBehaviors: No signup retries, unauthorized account lookups or session lifecycle bypass; login verification and referral order remain unchanged.
